scope: Pinned initialization/lifetime constraints for the next live-thread observer; no thread payload coverage claimed.
requirements: Do not dump whole vthread_s storage. The factory initializes flags 0 through 7 only; flags 8 through 511 and the word-register array are not initialized there.
Track initialized flag/register writes or prove liveness before reading them. Do not initialize previously unspecified storage merely to make snapshots deterministic.
Register fully constructed thread identities after the factory establishes lifecycle fields and scope membership. Remove identities before cleanup/delete; never dereference retired pointers.
Inventory all live threads, not only scheduled events: event waiters and suspended parents retain state while absent from the scheduler queue.
Serialize initialized lifecycle flags, PC identity, scope/parent/child/wait relationships, contexts and event-control fields with referent coverage explicit.
Use logical live lengths for vector/string/real/object stacks and argument-depth arrays; do not read reserved capacity or inactive object slots.
Bind queued thread events and wait-chain links to registered lifetimes. Cover scheduling, suspension, fork/join, detachment and delayed deletion when reachable.
Test real restored field mutations, unchanged original/disabled/observed output and firmware continuation; code/context/object referents and freed storage remain independent requirements.
